page.layout: One page of text, centred. Title lines in decreasing sizes, then a small ornament (woodcut, not an engraving), then the printer's imprint and date.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a symmetrical floral or scroll device in a lozenge shape) between the author line and the imprint; no text. Small manuscript marks at the foot ("12" or similar) are handwriting and are left out. The date's final letters are partly obscured by a stain, so "LXII" is marked as uncertain. The "s" in "ostensum" and "Sive" is printed as a long s and is transcribed as s.
